entries.name: StateOracle
entries.description: Records which assertions apply to each protected contract (assertion adopter). Assertions are rule contracts that enforcers run offchain. Each adopter has a manager, approved by a registered admin verifier, who adds and removes its assertions. Every addition or removal records an activation or deactivation block 75 blocks ahead. An assertion is accepted only with a proof that a registered DA verifier checks against its ID.

whitelistEnabled.description: When true, only accounts on the registration allowlist can register adopters and add assertions.

adminVerifiers.description: Contracts that decide which account may become the manager of a given adopter.

daVerifiers.description: Contracts that check the proof submitted with a new assertion.

adopterManagers.description: The current manager of each registered adopter. A zero address means the manager was revoked.

entries.name: AdminVerifierWhitelist
entries.description: Admin verifier that lets an account register as the manager of an adopter only if a whitelist admin assigned that account to the adopter. It is consulted only at registration. A whitelist admin can also exclude an adopter, which deletes its assignment and blocks new ones until the releaser named in the exclusion lifts it.

assignedManagers.description: The account each adopter's manager registration is assigned to.

exclusions.description: Adopters excluded from registration and the account that can lift each exclusion.

entries.name: DAVerifierOnChain
entries.description: DA verifier that accepts an assertion only if the keccak256 hash of the submitted proof equals the assertion ID, so the bytes behind the ID are published onchain with the assertion.

entries.name: TimelockController
entries.description: A timelock with access control. The current minimum delay is 3d.

Executor.description: Executing proposals is only open to all addresses if this resolves to the 0x0 address

entries.name: CredibleRegistry
entries.description: Records the last block a whitelisted builder marked as credible. isCredibleBlock() returns true from the marker transaction to the end of that block, and for calls with a zero gas price such as simulations. Builder and delay changes are scheduled on the registry's own timelock and wait at least 3d.

timelockDelay.description: The minimum delay of the registry's timelock. The registry schedules every operation with the longer of this and MIN_TIMELOCK_DELAY.
